claim_one_line: TWO_HIGGS VERIFIED ON MAIN (P-351): the web seat's sealed H5 reproduces on main's own B1740 instrument (unmodified, a per-sector Higgs added outside it; control against B1740's stored row 0.0): with H_u = F_6 and H_d = F_22, both read S, c = 3, at 0.5625 + 2.6i on (2/5, 1/10), L_2, the six over measured 1.0099, 0.9103, 0.9831, 0.9377, 0.9381, 1.0519, chi2_six 1.1884 (the seat's 1.19); the full grid's minima 1.1884 (six) and 154.14 (nine), the same 14 rows below 16.75; the mixing aligned but small (|V_us|, |V_cb|, |V_ub| 0.187, 0.554, 0.392 of measured); D = 9. The mechanism of D = 9: on (2/5, k/10) the lepton twists are the down twists swapped up to half-periods, so the lepton spectrum equals the down spectrum (k even: every Higgs; k odd: a Higgs with no QI component, F_22's being about 1e-13), and with c = 3 the lepton ratios are Georgi-Jarlskog's by construction of the line family: the six are four numbers, and P-094 excludes D = 9 at 14 sigma. Main's instruments are immune to the jtheta nome-root caution (W144). A READING: the pair chosen by the data, c = 3 by hand, tau fitted, the nine fail. 0 of 19.
